title: Clinical Notes Summarization with LoRA Fine-tuning
description: Fine-tuned Mistral 7B using parameter-efficient LoRA with 4-bit quantization for clinical note summarization. Improved ROUGE-1 from 0.381 to 0.423 (11% improvement). Achieved 17.9-minute training time through parameter-efficient fine-tuning. Processed Asclepius-Synthetic-Clinical-Notes dataset with custom filtering.
